diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users only depends on google_alloydb_cluster.primary (via the cluster attribute), but creating database users in an AlloyDB cluster requires the cluster's primary instance to exist and be ready first. The provider documentation's own google_alloydb_user examples include depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.default] for this reason. Without this ordering, user creation can race ahead of instance provisioning and fail.
